name: oss-contrib-v2
description: LangChain4j OSS contribution pipeline v2. Per-run timestamped output (candidates/issues/prs), three focused agents (finder/reviewer/contributor), and a single _learnings.md feedback loop that makes discovery smarter each run. Discovers and verifies contribution candidates, creates a git branch with tested changes and a commit, and drafts issues/PRs for manual human submission.
